clue.text: Italian article about love letter

indicators.note: about means the Italian-plus-article string goes around the love piece

parts.note: IT, short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and it
love is nil in tennis scoring, written as the round letter O
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A grammar point: an Italian article placed around the word for love.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek alphabet's ninth character, its smallest, is this letter.

clue.text: Encourages understandings by word of mouth

indicators.note: by word of mouth means the word for understandings is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: insights are understandings

explanation.surface: Encouraging comprehension through speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: To spur on or stir up someone is to urge them on.

clue.text: Vehicle traffic

definitions.meaning: dealings, as in to have no ... with

explanation.surface: Lorries in heavy traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: A goods lorry is one sense; dealings or barter, as in having no truck with someone, is the other.

clue.text: Entrenched person of note

parts.note: a notable figure famous for a great trench: the Mercian king whose dyke runs along the Welsh border

explanation.surface: A distinguished person dug in and immovable.
explanation.definitionFit: The eighth-century Mercian king is remembered for the earthwork dyke, a long bank and ditch, that bears his name.

clue.text: Put the final touches to curtains

explanation.surface: Completing a room by hanging curtains.
explanation.definitionFit: To complete or polish is one sense; the end, informally curtains, is the other.

clue.text: Pistol and Iago, for instance, as changed characters

indicators.note: the characters, meaning letters, of the word are changed around

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's Pistol and Iago as characters who have been altered.
explanation.walkthrough: Iago is Othello's 'ancient', and Pistol is called Ancient Pistol: ancient was an old word for an ensign. 'characters' suggests stage roles but means letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Both Shakespeare figures hold the rank of ancient, an old word for an ensign or standard-bearer.

clue.text: Physically weak American woman

definitions.meaning: dated US slang for a girl or woman

explanation.surface: Describing a woman from the States as feeble.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeble or delicate describes it; old American slang also used the word for a dame or girl.

clue.text: Do what I say editorially and play the game

definitions.text: Do what I say editorially and play the game

parts.words: Do what I say editorially and play the game
parts.note: an editor's command to obey, using editorial 'my', which is also the name of a children's game of imitating the one in front

explanation.surface: An editor tells staff to do as told and play fair.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's game in which everyone copies the actions of the one at the front.

clue.text: Slander, for instance, one physically present

parts.note: as means for instance, as in 'birds as sparrows'
one is I, and physically present means in person, so I is put in PERSON

explanation.surface: Slander, say, by someone actually there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'physically present' gives IN PERSON, which reads as the instruction to put I (one) inside PERSON before O.
explanation.definitionFit: A damaging, defamatory remark is a calumny or slur.

clue.text: Lavatory the king has to visit gets brief inspection

parts.note: loo is British informal for lavatory
K is the chess abbreviation for king
to see someone is to visit them

explanation.surface: A monarch's trip to the toilet becomes a quick inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick glance or a short peek is this informal term.

clue.text: If you have a good seat they should protect it

definitions.text: If you have a good seat they should protect it

parts.words: If you have a good seat they should protect it
parts.note: a good seat is skilled posture on horseback, but read also as a person's backside, covered by the garments in question

explanation.surface: Advice about protecting a good seat, as at a theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: Jodhpur-like trousers worn for horse riding cover the rider's backside.

clue.text: Warning card

definitions.meaning: a card is an amusing, eccentric person

explanation.surface: A referee's warning card.
explanation.definitionFit: An admonition is one sense; an amusing eccentric person, a real character, is the other.

clue.text: Sea nymph not caught by a Cyclops in disarray

indicators.note: in disarray says the letters are thrown into a new order
not says the abbreviation for caught is dropped from the word Cyclops

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A sea nymph escapes capture by a confused one-eyed giant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not caught' drops C from CYCLOPS, leaving CYLOPS; with A these are rearranged ('in disarray').
explanation.definitionFit: In the Odyssey the nymph who kept Odysseus on her island for seven years bears this name.

clue.text: Appropriate point to challenge

parts.note: to appropriate is to take for oneself
an issue is a point under discussion

explanation.surface: Seizing on a suitable point in order to dispute it.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispute or object to something is to disagree with it openly.

clue.text: Sort of iris that often takes root

definitions.text: Sort of iris that often takes root

parts.words: Sort of iris that often takes root
parts.note: a kind of iris whose name is usually followed by the word root, the fragrant rhizome used in perfume

explanation.surface: A gardening note about an iris that roots readily.
explanation.definitionFit: A Florentine iris whose dried rootstock, used in perfumery, is commonly called by its name plus root.

clue.text: Nothing touches nettle beer

indicators.note: touches means the nothing piece sits right against the nettle piece

parts.note: to nettle is to sting or irritate
nothing is zero, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A home brew made from nettles.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong old English ale goes by this name.

clue.text: Shop worker who will answer your questions

definitions.meaning: one who shops, that is informs on, others
a person interviewed by a researcher

explanation.surface: A shop assistant who will help with enquiries.
explanation.definitionFit: A police grass, one who shops people, is one sense; a person who supplies information to a researcher is the other.

clue.text: Sort of poisoning that caused Tom Paine's first set-back

indicators.note: Paine's first letter is shifted to the very front of the name, a set-back in its position

parts.note: taken as written
the surname of the radical pamphleteer, taken as written

explanation.surface: The radical Tom Paine suffered a setback through food poisoning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first set-back' takes P, the first letter of Paine, and moves it to the front of TOMPAINE.
explanation.definitionFit: The old name for bacterial food poisoning comes from compounds formed in rotting protein.

clue.text: Women lacking new opportunities to go out

indicators.note: lacking means the letter for new is removed

parts.note: a dated term, now offensive, for Black women

explanation.surface: Women denied new chances to get out.
explanation.definitionFit: Exits, ways out of a place, are the plural noun used here.

clue.text: Following newspaper in appeal for right to vote

indicators.note: in means the following-plus-newspaper pieces go inside the appeal piece

parts.note: to sue is to appeal or plead
ff is the abbreviation for 'and following' pages in references
a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper campaign appealing for votes for all.
explanation.definitionFit: The franchise, the right to vote in elections, is this word.

clue.text: Went on a course as directed

definitions.meaning: followed a route, as a helmsman does

explanation.surface: Someone following a course of study as instructed.
explanation.definitionFit: Guided a vessel along a route is one sense; guided or controlled is the other.

clue.text: Bird circling lake — a quail?

indicators.note: circling means the bird goes around the lake letter

parts.note: a finch is a small songbird
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A bird flying round a lake: is it a quail?
explanation.walkthrough: 'quail' looks like another bird, but it is the verb: to shrink back.
explanation.definitionFit: To quail is to shrink back in fear, to wince.

clue.text: Plant that's death to poultry

parts.note: a hen is a domestic fowl
bane is something deadly, poison

explanation.surface: A plant that kills chickens.
explanation.definitionFit: A poisonous nightshade-family plant with sticky leaves and foul smell bears this name.

clue.text: Throw out article accepted in error

indicators.note: accepted in means the article is taken into the word for error

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An article rejected because it was taken on by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel or exile is to send away.

clue.text: Examine outside state, shown lofty house

indicators.note: outside means the examine piece wraps around the state abbreviation

parts.note: to eye something is to examine it
RI is the abbreviation for Rhode Island, a US state

explanation.surface: Looking over a state house built up high.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle's nest built high on a crag is a home up high.

clue.text: Nominate a drunk for discharge

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters reel about into a new order

explanation.surface: Proposing an inebriated person for dismissal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flowing or issuing out from a source is an outflow or discharge.

clue.text: New trio flounders in opening passage

indicators.note: flounders suggests struggling clumsily, so the letters tumble into a new order

explanation.surface: A new trio struggles through the opening bars.
explanation.definitionFit: The introductory section of a piece of music is its opening.

clue.text: Succeeds in achieving stretches between bends

definitions.meaning: straight sections of a river between bends

explanation.surface: Someone who achieves success along a winding river.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrive at or attain is one sense; lengths of river between bends are the other.

clue.text: Way of selling art that is in fashion

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape anew, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A method of selling art that is currently trendy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in fashion' looks like a phrase meaning trendy; 'in' is fodder and 'fashion' the anagram signal. Inertia selling sends unrequested goods and demands payment unless returned.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia selling is a sales method relying on customers not bothering to return unsolicited goods.

clue.text: Fixed commercial return for fruit

indicators.note: return means the joined pieces are read backwards

parts.note: set means fixed
an ad is a commercial

explanation.surface: A fixed commercial return on a fruit crop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns SETAD to make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit of the palm tree, sweet and sticky, is the answer.

clue.text: Singular old house in foreign quarter.

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: A lone old house in a district of foreigners.
explanation.walkthrough: SOHO is a London district long known for its immigrant communities and foreign restaurants.
explanation.definitionFit: This central London district was historically settled by French, Italian and other immigrants.

clue.text: Sheltered accommodation for a chap

definitions.meaning: a small sheltered bay where boats can lie
old slang for a fellow or man

explanation.surface: Housing for an elderly man in sheltered accommodation.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sheltered inlet is one sense; an old slang word for a fellow is the other.
